title: Rainier schedule import and roster revision acceptance
method: Recorded agent tests of copied application code using manufactured workbook and disposable dashboard data; not rerun for this portfolio update.

metadata_defect.requirement: A selected Sunday must not bypass worksheet metadata validation.
metadata_defect.before: Mismatched worksheet station rejected with inferred dates but accepted on an explicit-Sunday first import into a manufactured database.
metadata_defect.correction: Always validate matching metadata, retain export timestamp, infer year from source and compare the selected Sunday with source dates.
metadata_defect.after: Installed parser copy rejected the mismatch in both paths; all 14 malformed cases also rejected with explicit dates.
metadata_defect.boundary: Installed on-disk fix was verified in isolation; loading by a running service was not established.

checks.requirement: Preview must be distinct from durable save
checks.observed: Preview labeled unsaved; revision list empty before explicit save.

checks.requirement: Entered fields survive save and reopen
checks.observed: Keyboard-entered note, route count 1, target 1 and attendance retained in saved revision.

checks.requirement: Review should not overwrite current editor draft
checks.observed: Different editor-only draft remained after reviewing saved revision.
Saved note and target returned to the editor.

checks.requirement: Undo restores editor draft without rewriting saved history
checks.observed: Editor-only draft returned; stored saved revision stayed unchanged.

roster_revision_workflow.test_harness_issue: Fill-only automation did not commit onchange-backed fields. Successful checks used keyboard entry, Tab and redraw verification; two early trial revisions were retained.
roster_revision_workflow.boundary: This automation behavior is not evidence of an ordinary-user application data-loss defect.
